name: E10_route_B_synthetic_detector
question: Can a stride-2 point detector trained only on synthetic endothelium (exact centres, no human point labels) reach the E4 break-evens on real images (misses ~8 %, jitter ~0.17 x spacing, FP ~14 %) or at least clearly move miss / jitter toward them?
data: experiments/meta_ceiling_20261103/synth_data/v1 (3000 images, 972x1296 uint8 raw-like; meta: centres of all cells, instance map, ROI, exact labels, params incl. framed). Normal CLAHE + 1/99 percentile pipeline. Cells under black (vignette) regions are dropped from the targets and from the scoring (tissue mask), so black counts as background.
step1_domain_check: shipped pre-only s46 (deploy/detectors/sg2pre_s46.pt, threshold 0.35, 5x5 peaks, 12-px NMS) on synthetic images vs exact centres inside the tissue and an 8-px inner margin: miss, FP, jitter (median matched distance / median NN spacing; match radius 0.5 x spacing) and 12-px F1; by framed / unframed. First ~24 images on CPU for an early signal, 200 on GPU in the lane job. Plausible if F1 is within 0.15 of the real validation-5 (0.644) and miss / FP / jitter within 0.10 of real (0.293 / 0.188 / 0.195); otherwise report what differs for the renderer fix before training.
step2_train: stride-2 specialist head (Linear 768 -> 16 + pixel-shuffle 4) on the fold-4 recipe A encoder (image-level labels only; the 25 annotated images are in fold 4 and were never seen by it), initialised fresh, trained on synthetic images only: Gaussian targets sigma 8 on all in-tissue centres with full-frame support, four flips, batch 2, 4000 updates, encoder lr 1e-5 / head 1e-3, AdamW wd 1e-4, clip 1, bf16. No real point label is used. Scored on all 25 annotated real images (all clean) at threshold 0.35 with the same metrics, next to the shipped pre-only s46 scored by the same code.
gate_step2: route B stays open if on the 25 real images miss <= 0.15 or jitter <= 0.17 with FP <= 0.30 (shipped pre-only on all-25: miss 0.174 / FP 0.147 / jitter 0.216; val-5 0.166 / 0.166 / 0.222), i.e. a clear move of >= 0.03 miss or >= 0.04 jitter toward the E4 break-evens; otherwise closed.
step3_conditional: only if the gate passes: fine-tune on the 20 train-green images (1000 updates, as the pre-only fine-tune), re-score on the validation-5, then fold-clean OOF peaks and the hex6 member check against the shipped ten (D2c gates).
gpu: lane01 after the parent's meta_bridge_f0_enc_lr5x (~03:30 UTC): domain check 200 on GPU 1 in parallel with training on GPU 0 (~25 min), then score25 on GPU 0. CPU early check runs now with the free-quota pool rule (single process, 4 threads).
